fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our 2016 fuel consumption, a hypothetical ten percent increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel (excluding the effect of the fuel tax refund) would have increased fuel expense by approximately $26.4 million for the 2016 year.

instrument_type_details.notes: Company states 'have not hedged fuel price risk in recent years'.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel expense for 2016 decreased $21.1 million, or 7.6 percent, compared with 2015. The decrease was primarily the result of a 19.9 percent decrease in system average cost per gallon to $1.49 per gallon. This was offset by a 15.2 percent increase in system fuel gallons consumed. [Derived: 150.0M × 1.152 = 172.8M gallons]
